meta.name: github
meta.description: GitHub operations via `gh` CLI: issues, PRs, CI runs, code review, API queries. Use when: (1) checking PR status or CI, (2) creating/commenting on issues, (3) listing/filtering PRs or issues, (4) viewing run logs. NOT for: complex web UI interactions requiring manual browser flows (use browser tooling when available), bulk operations across many repos (script with gh api), or when gh auth is not configured.

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理 GitHub 仓库、PR 和 CI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在终端操作 GitHub 而不想打开浏览器
copy.tagline_en: Manage GitHub repos, PRs, and CI from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with GitHub from the terminal

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 gh 命令行工具执行 GitHub 仓库操作，例如查看问题（issues）、拉取请求（PRs）、CI 运行状态、查询 API 等。
howto.when: 当用户需要检查 PR 状态或 CI、创建或评论 issue、列出或筛选 PR/issue、查看工作流运行日志时触发。

say.text: 检查仓库 owner/repo 的 PR #55 状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 gh 命令并返回 PR 详情。

say.text: 创建一个新 issue，标题为“登录页面样式问题”。
say.note: Claude 会使用 gh issue create 创建。

say.text: 列出仓库 owner/repo 最近的 CI 运行日志。
say.note: Claude 会调用 gh run list 并显示结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform GitHub repository operations via the gh CLI, such as managing issues, pull requests, CI runs, and API queries.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to check PR status or CI, create or comment on issues, list or filter PRs/issues, or view workflow run logs.

say_en.text: Check the status of PR #55 in repo owner/repo.
say_en.note: Claude runs gh pr view and returns details.

say_en.text: Create a new issue titled 'Login page style issue'.
List recent CI runs for repo owner/repo.
say_en.note: Claude runs gh run list and shows results.
